name: Langbiang Mountain
kicker: The peak north of town, by jeep or on foot
summary: Ride a jeep or hike up Lang Biang, the mountain north of Da Lat, for the view over pine ridges, farm valleys, and a lake far below. It is the half-day that shows you the highlands rather than the town. Go early, when the cloud is still off the top.
heroCaption: The view from the top of Lang Biang over the valley and the lake

notice.title: The ticket is the tourism park
notice.body: Lang Biang is a ticketed tourism zone with a gate. The package you buy sets what is included, such as the jeep up. It is not a free hill walk outside the fence.

body: Lang Biang rises north of the city, and the tourism zone at 93A Bidoup is the way up. The green jeeps carry you toward the viewpoints, or you hike it. From the top the land opens out: pine ridges, farm valleys, and water in the hollows below.
Give it a half day with the ride out and back. The gate sells packages, so choose the jeep if you want the view without the climb, and bring a layer from November to January.

figures.caption: A tourist jeep below the LANGBIANG letters
figures.alt: Green tourist jeep on the road below the Langbiang sign on a grassy hill

gettingThere: Lang Biang is north of the centre, at the tourism zone on 93A Bidoup. Take a taxi or Grab from Xuan Huong Lake, or ride a motorbike if you hold the right licence.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: Taxi, Grab, or motorbike north to 93A Bidoup.

legs.heading: From the gate
legs.body: Jeep or hike toward the peak viewpoints.

admissionNote: 155,000–420,000 VND depending on the package (Visit Lâm Đồng, Langbiang Land). The package sets whether the jeep is included. Confirm at the gate. The provincial page gives about 60 minutes for the visit itself; with the road, plan a half day.
